verdict.rationale: Orrick's own Global Employment & Equity Compensation Solutions page describes a 70+ lawyer team offering a one-stop shop for global equity and HR legal issues across jurisdictions on a fixed-fee basis. That directly supports multi-jurisdiction equity compensation work, but the evidence never names designing option plans or any local schemes. missing for 10: explicit option-plan design services, named local schemes (UK EMI, German VSOP/ESOP, Indian ESOPs), program-design detail on its own pages, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm designs employee equity programs — option plans and local schemes like UK EMI, German VSOP/ESOP, or Indian ESOPs — described on its own pages

citations.quote: a true one-stop shop for global equity and HR legal issues, offering you a single point of contact for all your needs worldwide ... solutions that drive uniformity across jurisdictions – all on a fixed-fee basis
